mods.name: Pikmin 3: Extra Side of Stories
mods.author: Tong
mods.description:
A mission mode expansion pack following the events of the Side Story featured in Pikmin 3 Deluxe.

Olimar's Mission - consists of 15 remixed levels for Collect Treasure, making enough money to buy the dolphin.

Louie Stories - A solo adventure starring Louie, battling enemies to take back home and cook at his restaurant that Olimar help fund after his mission.

Also featuring a minigames mode, (Deluxe only) Brand new stages for you to play designed from a variety of Pikmin 3 modders.

mods.name: Pikmin 3- Original Leaders
mods.author: Niment
mods.description:
Olimar, Louie, and the President return as playable characters in Pikmin 3! 
They replace Alph, Brittany, and Charlie respectively. Alph and Brittany replace Olimar and Louie respectively. The President uses a custom made model made using parts from the Lucky Marble item, Parts from Olimar, and original elements so that he can look accurate to his appearance in Pikmin 2 while also appearing modernized just as Olimar and Louie were in the jump for Pikmin 2 to 3. Also included is a version of the mod with an appearance for the President that is more similar to his in game model from Pikmin 2.

There are 4 Versions of this mod to chose from:

    Olimar, Louie, and President over Alph, Brittany, and Charlie
    Olimar, Louie, and President over Alph, Brittany, and Charlie  (alternate President style)
    President over Charlie
    President over Charlie (alternate style)


In summary, this mod includes model replacements for each leader which replaces them with their counterpart from Pikmin 2/3. It also includes UI changes to reflect the new leaders. They all have cutscene models as well meaning they are fully compatible with Story Mode. however their animations do tend to get a little weird in some instances which will likely be fixed at a later date.


Features that may be Included in the Future:

    Changed story mode text to go along with the 3 Original Leaders gathering fruit for Koppai.
    Improved Cutscene Animations
    Changed Voice Clips 
    A Port of this mod for Pikmin 3: Deluxe
    Changed Helmet Light Colors for the Leaders as well as other Color changes (UI, Outlines, Etc)
    Other adjustments based on feedback

mods.name: Pikmin 3 +5 NEW Challenge Levels
mods.author: Gimmicking
mods.description:
Uses the assets in the game without too much overall change. The first 5 mission mode stages in this hack have been changed to be a completely different experience. This is my first hack, and it came out on Christmas 2022. 

I hope you all enjoy :)

mods.name: 90 Minute time limit for ALL missions.
mods.author: joered05
mods.description:
I simple mod that changes the timer in mission mode from there original limit to 90 Minutes. It changes ALL levels in Treasure collect, Battle enemies, and Battle bosses. It works with DLC too!
I wouldn't recommend connecting to leader boards while this mod is active. I doubt anything will happen, but better safe than sorry!

This is my very first mod i have ever done for a Wii U game so i thought i should make a simple mod that i didn't see anywhere else, and because i wanted to mess around in mission mode for fun.


Bugs & Tested Levels:
Right now i don't know of any bugs with this mod.
Tested levels:
   Treasure Collect:
   All levels tested and work as intended.

   Battle Enemies:
   All levels tested except 3, 4, and 5. (Expected to work, just haven't tested it)

   Battle Bosses:
   All 6 levels tested and work as intended.

If you find any bugs or any issues with the mod feel free to tell me about them and i will attempt to fix it.
mods.changelog:
Update 6/8/2019:
   Tested levels 3, 4, and 5 in Treasure Collect. All work as intended.

mods.name: Decor Pikmin - Burger Set
mods.author: Dekgear
mods.description:
Want to add more flavour to your Pikmin experience? This is for you!

This mod adds Decor Pikmin from Pikmin Bloom into the game! Especifically from the "Burger" set AKA Fast Food costumes!

Models and textures of the costumes were simplified so the game could handle them better.

You can install it with SDCafiine on Wii U, or as a graphic pack on CEMU (untested)

mods.name: Hyper Wraith Boss Fight
mods.author: QuoteBalrog
mods.description: This is a harder version of the Plasm Wraith in Mission Mode where he attacks faster, runs faster, and has more hp during the same 12 minute timer. There is also an unkillable Meerslug that is meant there as a distraction. Good luck if you can try to kill this beast.

mods.name: No HUD on KopPad camera+ No shop icon on title
mods.author: Dekgear
mods.description:
This is a simple mod that removes the HUD when using the KopPad camera and also the e-shop icon from the Title Screen

This allows easier screenshoot takings from the first person camera of the KopPad, which is otherwise not very useful as it can't upload screenshots to Miiverse anymore.

Also removes the e-shop icon from the title screen, which is now useless as there's no e-shop anymore, and even if you had the DLC installed it would still show up.

Works with SDCafiine or as a CEMU Graphic Pack.
mods.changelog:
e-shop icon removal
-Removes e-shop icon from the Title Screen. Also added rules.txt so it can be used as a graphic pack.

mods.name: Decor Pikmin - Pharmacy set
mods.author: Dekgear
mods.description: Gives all Pikmin dental hygiene costumes from Pikmin Bloom! Also, remember to brush your teeth if you haven't already!

mods.name: More helpful "End Day" warning (ENG)
mods.author: Sven Cakemann
mods.description:
Apparently, in the Wii U release of Pikmin 3 in English only, the game does not list how many Pikmin will be left behind if the day is ended early without having all the Pikmin in a safe location. Every other language is specific in saying how many Pikmin will be lost. This edits the msbt text string to show exactly how many will be left behind. I'm not sure if this was something that was fixed in the Deluxe release of the game on Switch, but if it wasn't, go ahead and port it over.

This mod will not have any affect on your game unless you play it in English (EU) or English (US).

mods.name: Dandori Olimar
mods.author: Sven Cakemann
mods.description:
Replaces the gameplay version of Captain Olimar with his appearance in Pikmin 4. This is only for Pikmin 3, not Pikmin 3 Deluxe; it should work on Wii U console, but has only been tested on Cemu as of right now. I don't own P3 Deluxe, so I'm unable to test/port it myself. If you are interested in porting it, please reach out to me.

This changes most, but not all, of Captain Olimar's UI to match. 

Future changes:
Model to replace cutscene appearances
Replacing remaining UI elements that I may have missed

mods.name: Pikmin 4 title screen music
mods.author: Sven Cakemann
mods.description: Replaces Pikmin 3's title music with that of Pikmin 4.

mods.name: GameStop Event's Tropical Forest layout
mods.author: SmacAttac
mods.description:
Long story short, man spends about a week trying to crack open an old Wii U kiosk disc, finds out he was wasting his time after finding an in your face solution, finds out the contents are actually REALLY uninteresting and very similar to final (which in hindsight, given the demo was made on July 9th, about a month before release, I really shouldn't be that surprised) so he decides to salvage at least something from time wasted. 

In this case, the exclusive Tropical Forest layout used only for this demo, which was made for a GameStop event around the time, those who attended from July 19th-20th and preordered P3 at the store were given a code to play the game a day early on August 3, 2013. Apparently a lot of those codes given didn't actually work which was a fiasco in itself.
